_comment: Net class overrides for hw/kicad-tools/return_path/return_path_check.py, which finds this file next to the board. Keys are net-name globs, values one of: rf, clock, high-speed, analog, medium, low-speed, static, unclassified. First match wins; unmatched nets fall back to the script's name rules. Why: GPIO_0 is the ES8388 MCLK; C35-Pad1 is the 40 MHz crystal; C1/C21/C24/C26 are the output coupling caps; Q2-D is the switched CH340 supply; D?-A are LED anodes.
